macrophage_identity: Existing lineage identity; independent of PGAM5 grouping
macrophage_RNA_marker_corroboration: Descriptive >=2 core and >=1 broad-myeloid genes, not a validated classifier or exclusion rule
other_lineage_RNA_review_flag: Co-detection of >=2 epithelial/hepatocyte or >=2 lymphoid panel genes, not a doublet or contamination diagnosis
PGAM5_related_state: Unresolved: no separate biological RNA subtype inferred by a score threshold
candidate_module_continuous_rank_score: Mean log1p(CP10k) of the50 final equal-cell exploratory features; descriptive, not a cell-fraction unit
candidate_module_*_feature_coverage: Fraction of selected genes actually measurable; complete coverage required for score
RNA_state_validation_passed: Separate multigene subtype not established; not required for the operational RNA label
usable_for_validated_TCGA_PGAM5_cell_abu: False, current internal mixture recovery and bulk/cell-RNA unit calibration fail or are unavailable
